Checked the banking stub; routing/ABA look standard for Meridian Trust. Next steps from FinOps:

1) We'll kick off verification via micro-deposits (two micro-deposits under $0.50) to the ACH account Elena provided. Expect them within 48–72 hours after we trigger.
2) Please confirm the account holder name matches the W-9 — Elena, can you send the W-9 to this thread? (send as PDF).

4) For wire fallback, include both ABA and our internal payment reference: Redwood PAYREF:<vendor-name>-<shortid>.

I attached a short doc with micro-deposit expectations and how to report the amounts back to us (micro_deposit_instructions.docx). Once micro-deposits verified and W-9 received, we'll mark vendor active and schedule first payout.

Marissa — looping you for PO creation cadence once vendor is active.
